findings.evidence: `Mathlib/Tactic/Translate/ToAdditive.lean:50-53` states that an existing documentation string is not automatically used; grep confirms each listed attribute has only a target name (and sometimes `attr := simp`), so the generated public theorem is undocumented.
findings.fix: Supply an accurate `/-- ... -/` argument to each listed `to_additive` attribute, as already done for the translated definitions.
findings.issue: Every theorem translation uses `@[to_additive <name>]` without an additive docstring: Basic lines 70, 81, 89; Decomposition lines 99, 115, 127, 135, 146, 158, 173; Congr/Left lines 151, 159, 168, 183, 189, 195, 204, 212, 218, 225, 230; Finite lines 57, 63, 70, 80, 87; Sum lines 88, 94, 100, 108, 119, 132, 168, 181.

summary: The additive definitions are documented, but all 34 additive theorems generated by `to_additive` lack docstrings because source docstrings are not inherited automatically.
